patch.value: Render package visuals with build-time Triplicate tokens
Restyle every diagram format from pinned pm-brand values; preserve export behavior and prove light/dark accessibility with real tracker renders, regression and revert evidence.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Design: form-paper canvas and ruled top sheets; carbon text, Martian Mono ids and dates, explicit status labels and contract chip fills. Canary and rose only convey in_progress and blocked. Brand values are generated at build time from an exact devDependency; published runtime has no brand dependency or CDN fetches. Existing scheduling, graph edges and serialization stay intact.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Render review uses seven captured public brand-kit tracker items. Critical and overdue indicators preserve status fills. Mermaid initialization precedes the diagram header; native single-line task labels retain mono data. Behavioral revert proof independently restores only renderSvg, renderHtml, then renderMermaid in disposable source copies: each unchanged real-tracker regression fails 1/1; restoring the implementation passes 1/1. The immutable README banner points to pm-brand commit 5c80a2b707f3a00afe986e81e520843b86f3ee83. Full npm/Bun gates and final browser capture are pending.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The final 390 px browser review found CSS table columns constraining the mobile card body. The timeline table now becomes a full-width block, hides its desktop column definitions, and keeps all four week headings visible. At 390 px each item is 348 px wide with a maximum 70 px label height; light/dark at 1x/2x pass with no page overflow. Reverting only the mobile CSS to the prior Triplicate implementation makes the browser assertion fail. The 80 existing SVG/scheduler tests pass after the correction.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Render review caught Mermaid-prefixed task IDs and important native label styles bypassing state colors. Portable ID-suffix selectors now cover native and prefixed IDs, override native text styles, and theme excluded days and section paper. Real-tracker focused tests pass 5/5; independent renderer revert proofs remain 1/1 failures for SVG, HTML and Mermaid with 1/1 passes restored. Computed-color browser checks and full release gates are being rerun on this implementation.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Created follow-up pm-gantt-chart-sdk-docs for installation prose that calls the 2026.10.6 consumer minimum the development SDK pin; the actual development dependency is 2026.10.13. This visual change leaves SDK and consumer minimum pins as-is.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The first frozen full npm suite passed 249/249 tests but correctly failed the unchanged 100% branch gate at 99.88%. The missing Mermaid critical-outline branch is now covered by a real tracker dependency chain and its computed critical rows. Focused tests pass 5/5. In a scratch copy, reverting only the critical outline from 3px to 1px makes the new assertion fail 1/1. All 72 before/after PNGs are published on pr-screenshots; the 36 after cases pass at all widths, themes and scales with no overflow, animations, interactive actions or external requests. CI-isolated strict tracker health passes, with existing advisories retained.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The real critical-path case now reaches the unchanged 100/100/100 runtime coverage floor with 249/249 tests. Before finalizing, extended the contrast test to measure state text on paper and sheet as well as chip backgrounds, covering Mermaid labels outside short bars. All 44 text/background checks and four focus pairs pass across both themes; the focused suite remains 5/5. Runtime files and published renders are unchanged. Full npm and Bun gates are being rerun with this final test matrix.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Both CI-isolated npm run release:check and bun run release:check pass: each 249/249 tests; 100% lines, branches and functions over all 3 intended runtime sources, zero failed, canceled or skipped tests. The pinned pm runner passes focused tests 5/5; project test execution tracking remains disabled by existing policy, so results are recorded here. Published 72 before/after PNGs on pr-screenshots, with 36 after cases passing widths/themes/scales, no overflow, animations, interactive actions or external requests. Renderer hashes match the published evidence. Independent renderer reverts fail 1/1 each and restored renderers pass 1/1. Strict CI-isolated tracker health passes with existing advisories retained. CI retains Node 22 coverage and runs both full release gates on Node 26 without a redundant third coverage run. No brand token gap found; pm-brand release remains held. Claim released for orchestrator verification; item stays in progress.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: CI on Bun 1.4.3 failed before the full release checks: npm-lock migration compared the Git kit download with npm prepared-archive integrity. A fresh-cache minimal reproduction fails with the original entry and passes when only that optional integrity field is removed. The exact approved commit and all registry dependency integrity values stay pinned. Applying this lock-only repair and validating fresh npm and Bun installs; renderer values and published PNGs remain unchanged.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Fresh npm ci and clean-cache Bun 1.4.3 install both pass after removing only the optional integrity field from the exact Git dependency. brand:check and a fresh build pass; committed dist and renderer hashes are unchanged. The original lock entry reproduces IntegrityCheckFailed while the commit-only entry installs successfully. Registry integrity checks remain intact. CI will rerun both complete release gates on this installation-metadata repair. Hound uses an ES5 parser on generated ESM; separate follow-up pm-gantt-chart-hound-esm records its 45 false syntax findings. Kit release remains held.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round 1: address Hound ES5 parser false positives via the sibling generated-output exclusion, keep the exact pm-brand main pin current, run npm and Bun release gates, then reply and resolve only the 19 Hound threads.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round 1 gates pass under isolated CI Git identity: npm and Bun release:check each 249/249 tests with 100% lines/branches/functions, zero duplication and three packed consumer scenarios. The linked visual/token suite passes 5/5. Hound generated-output exclusions match pm-graph without disabling source lint. The pm-brand main pin is unchanged at 7ad0970d96a20c24b8dbd9e0dcd1efeb8b4d5cc1; verify it again before pushing. Existing visual evidence remains applicable because output bytes are unchanged. Brand release stays held.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round 2: replace the outdated ASCII-only package description with a sentence matching the current renderer, formats, dependency scheduling and Triplicate styling. Align the README opening and tell the banner PR to refresh descriptions on its next generation.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Issue 153 confirmed: SVG paint attributes depend on unsupported CSS variables. Emit literal light paint attributes plus literal light/dark CSS overrides, keeping browser theme selection. Add a five-status resvg raster regression asserting paper, ink, canary, rose and stamp pixels, and a function-only renderSvg revert. Native desktop renderers are unavailable on this host.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round 2 evidence: resvg produces a readable five-state chart; the native pixel regression passes and reverting only renderSvg fails, restored implementation passes. Token-like user text remains unchanged. Browser captures cover 1440/768/390, light/dark, 1x/2x; all 12 after cases have no horizontal overflow, animation or interactive actions, correct theme paper, and zero external requests. Evidence is on the pr-screenshots branch under brand/triplicate-visuals/round2.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Existing SVG scaffolding, progress-band and paint-order assertions now inspect literal contract paints; their original state, opacity and TODAY ordering requirements are retained. The raster oracle requires exact solid paper, sheet, canary and rose fills and permits antialiasing only for ink/stamp edges. Full npm/Bun gates are being rerun with bounded process parallelism after incomplete resource-contention runs.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final targeted validation passes 22/22 SVG and Triplicate tests with zero failures/skips. The final portable harness catches the old renderSvg function (1/1 failure) and the restored implementation passes 1/1. Build/typecheck and 0% duplication pass. Push the prepared source and generated artifacts for exact-head CI; full local npm/Bun validation remains in progress under bounded parallelism.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Exact-head CI run 39094703019 at d86b87d2405e0ea428178114ed06bdf0b1d76c92 passes Node 22.18 and Node 26. Node 26 npm run release:check and bun run release:check each pass 250/250 tests, zero failures/cancellations/skips/TODOs, and 100% lines/branches/functions at unchanged thresholds. The packed npm/Bun/minimum-host acceptance, tracked project health, fresh-build parity, audit and changelog checks pass. The 22/22 focused tests and final function-only SVG revert are independently recorded. Item stays in progress; release ownership for orchestrator verification.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round 3: address all four current review findings and the item-title clipping reported in screenshot review. Preserve full accessible titles, pin the behavioral baseline, verify rendered glyph pixels, and explicitly retain pending Inkscape acceptance. Re-pin the brand kit to current main; release gates and refreshed screenshots precede push.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: All three focused visual tests pass. The SVG and HTML and Mermaid normal-mode reverts still fail independently against the pinned pre-change revision. The label-only round-2 renderer revert fails the new complete-word/full-title test, then the restored renderer passes. Glyph pixels are compared against a text-free raster using a checked-in licensed DejaVu subset with system-font loading disabled. README and package description already use general pm-cli renderer wording; repository merge-driver documentation is technical mechanics, not brand copy.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round 3 evidence is complete: three focused visual tests pass; the normal renderer-only reverts fail independently against the fixed pre-change baseline, and label-only plus glyph-removal mutations each fail one unchanged regression then pass restored. Linked label and glyph proof commands pass. Twelve refreshed SVG screenshots cover all three widths, both themes and both pixel ratios with no overflow, motion, actions or external requests. Native Inkscape 1.4 remains pending; resvg is explicitly separate evidence. The exact brand pin is main commit 98cbe45976b3111f09143c2a29ede906cb553c2a, installed with Bun after a local npm Git-preparation stall. Both release gates are running; thresholds are unchanged.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round 4: read every unresolved thread and latest review plus related open issues. Verify prior safeguards; fix current findings with independent behavioral revert proofs, isolated npm and Bun release gates and exact-head CI. Leave threads unresolved and release held.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round 4 fixes legend clipping at minimum width by including all five chips plus page padding in the canvas minimum. The default-root generator parity test now reads only and asserts the shared source modification time stays unchanged. Add independent disposable mutation proofs. Issue 153 already has literal-paint and raster regression coverage; add its closing reference to the PR body while explicitly retaining pending native Inkscape 1.4 acceptance.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round 4 regression evidence: focused visual/token suite passes 8/8. node test/revert-review.ts catches two independent behavioral reverts: removing only the legend extent fails 1/1, restoring passes 1/1; restoring only the default-root write fails the unchanged modification-time assertion 1/1, restoring passes 1/1. Thresholds and source scope unchanged.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Round 4 browser evidence published on pr-screenshots at 45c9b6f: twelve synthetic minimum-width one-week before/after captures, origin/main versus proposed renderer, cover 1440/768/390 and light/dark. All have zero horizontal scroll, external requests, animation and interactive actions. This surface has no keyboard actions. Existing 44 AA text-pair and four focus contrast checks remain green. PM linked mutation proof passed; project policy disables automatic test-result storage, so receipts are recorded in comments.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Issue 153 function-only portable renderer proof rerun on round 4: reverting only renderSvg to the CSS-variable paint implementation fails the unchanged non-browser raster regression 1/1; restored implementation passes 1/1. Native Inkscape 1.4 acceptance remains pending and is not replaced by the resvg result.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final round-4 local gates: isolated Node 26 npm run release:check and bun run release:check both PASS, each 252/252 tests with zero failures/cancellations/skips/TODOs; 100% lines, branches and functions across all three intended runtime source files at unchanged thresholds. Zero duplication and production vulnerabilities; docstrings, brand parity, release workflow/date/attestation checks pass. All three packed scenarios pass: npm current and Bun current on the pinned development host plus npm minimum peer host. New legend and shared-write reverts each fail 1/1 and pass 1/1 restored; portable issue-153 renderer revert fails 1/1 and passes restored. Linked pm proof passes, existing result-storage policy stays disabled. Twelve narrow before/after screenshots are published. Fresh-clone strict health and exact-head CI follow the final commit. Native Inkscape 1.4 remains pending. Brand pin is current main 98cbe45976b3111f09143c2a29ede906cb553c2a and release stays held.
